scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,web -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:api" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,web -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
